summaries.senate: Polymarket odds for Democratic control of the Senate rose slightly, with the party remaining the market's favourite. The biggest move was in [[Nebraska]], where the Republican, Pete Ricketts, saw a sizable gain in their chances. In [[Ohio]], the Democrat Sherrod Brown gained ground by a moderate amount, and the market shows it as a predicted flip.
summaries.governor: The biggest move came in [[Nebraska]], where the Republican Jim Pillen saw a sizable gain in Polymarket odds. In [[Georgia]], the Democrat Keisha Lance Bottoms also gained ground, and the market now shows the race as a predicted flip. In [[Florida]], the Republican Byron Donalds slipped by a moderate amount.
summaries.house: Democrats remain the favoured party to win control of the House, and Polymarket odds for them edged up slightly today. In [[NC-13 (Fuquay-Varina & Sanford)]], the Republican Brad Knott saw a sharp drop in chances against the Democrat Paul Barringer. In [[FL-09 (Orlando & Kissimmee)]], the Republican Dan Green slipped by a sizable amount against the Democrat Darren Soto, and the market still lists the district as a predicted flip. The projected seat count moved to 238-197, down from 239-196, with the result still that Democrats gain control.
